name: SQLite 3.40 to support browser API, including OPFS #63
snippet: Jun 25, 2023 — the next SQLite non-patch release will contain a browser implementation, and that will include an Origin Private File System VFS for persistent storage.

name: Persistent Storage Options
snippet: The Origin-Private FileSystem, OPFS , is an API providing browser -side persistent storage which, not coincidentally, sqlite3 can use for storing databases. Read more

name: Web-SQLite-JS – Persistent SQLite in the browser via OPFS
snippet: Persistent SQLite in the browser via OPFS . Automatically uses OPFS for file storage. Applications are open till July 27.
